content:
Sam: morning — quick async pipeline check-in. dropping updates and blockers here.

Sam: Yesterday: closed LOI with Nova Health (legal review in progress). Uploaded security docs to the deal folder.

Priya: congrats! quick blocker: Nova legal asked for HSM/KMS integration timeline — they want details for their procurement.

Connor: replied to Nova legal with a tentative timeline: HSM integration for Dedicated ~6-8 weeks, Private depends on customer infra (on-prem work). cc @eng-infra for confirmation.

Maria: Yesterday: demo with Acero. They asked about FedRAMP posture and EU data residency. Blocker: we don't have FedRAMP; need comms for alternatives. Today: loop in compliance.

Raj: FYI — security checklist + architecture diag uploaded: https://drive.redwood.ai/sales/acero/security-checklist (permissions set to team).

Lisa: quick request from Acero — can eng provide an HSM/KMS readiness note (1-paragraph) by EOD? Sales needs to share tomorrow.

Connor: I can draft the note but need a quick confirm from infra on supported KMS providers. Free at 3pm PT for a 15m. @Lisa can you confirm?

Sam: I'll follow up after 3pm and update the deal card. Also pinging @security-bot for current SOC2/Security status.

security-bot: SOC2 status: Type II audit in progress, expected completion 2025-03-01. PCI / FedRAMP: no active FedRAMP package. (auto)

Priya: Deal updates summary: Nova Health — waiting security approval (HSM note). Acero — asked for perf/quantization numbers and EU residency options.

Miguel: shared perf snapshot here: https://perf.redwood.ai/reports/acero-q1 (90th/99th latencies by instance). Quantization support: Q8 available on Dedicated; Q4/Q5 experimental on Private with model-specific testing.

Maria: that's helpful — can you paste the headline numbers in a one-pager? Acero wants a short summary for procurement.

Miguel: will do. sending a 1-pager by EOD.

Raj: noted the data residency ask. I'll draft an EU options doc (SaaS in eu-region, dedicated in eu, on-prem guidance) and share tomorrow morning.

Sam: blockers recap: 1) HSM readiness note (owner: Connor), 2) FedRAMP question & alternatives (owner: Maria / compliance), 3) perf & quantization 1-pager for Acero (owner: Miguel). I'll create tasks in the pipeline board and tag owners.

Priya: perfect. please update deal cards when docs are uploaded. thumbs up if you saw this. :thumbsup:

Lisa: saw. I can share the draft ask with Acero once Connor posts the HSM note.

Sam: thanks team — short but actionable.
